Specification: This module provides a concrete model-checking instantiation for an echo-style protocol specified in another module. It defines a tiny three-node graph, chooses an initiator nondeterministically from those nodes, and gives two concrete graph descriptions: one graph as a function over node pairs and one graph chosen to satisfy connectivity, symmetry, and irreflexivity assumptions. The module also defines a test specification that prints the relation at startup and then runs the imported specification, plus a simple view and postcondition using TLC-specific operators.
IfThenElse: IF edge[1] = edge[2] THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE
FunctionConstructor:
[ edge \in (N1 \X N1) |-> IF edge[1] = edge[2] 
                                THEN FALSE
                                ELSE TRUE ]
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE r \in [ N1 \X N1 -> BOOLEAN ] : 
        /\ IsConnected(r, N1)
        /\ IsSymmetric(r, N1)
        /\ IsIrreflexive(r, N1)
